column3: NASB follows the critical text without “therefore.”
NASB renders “as what death” as “by what kind of death.”
NASB follows the critical text; “of yourself” is rendered “on your own initiative.”
NASB renders the question expecting “no” as “I am not a Jew, am I?”
NASB follows the critical text; “attendants” is rendered “servants,” and “from here” is “of this realm.”
NASB follows the critical text; “You say that I am a king” is rendered “You say correctly that I am a king.”
NASB follows the critical text without “all”; “insurrectionist” is rendered “robber.”
